name: GPU Economy - current cloud GPU rental prices
description: Latest publicly listed rental price per (provider, GPU, price type, region), normalized to USD per GPU per hour. Node-priced offers keep the listed node price and GPU count. A listing in another currency keeps the listed price (listed_currency, listed_price_hour) and the official reference rate and date used for the USD figure (ECB; the Bank of Russia for RUB and VND).
change_notices: Building on these files? Write to data@gpueconomy.com with who you are and which files and fields you use, and we will tell you before a field, a file address, a unit or the set of slices changes. Free; no key, no rate limit either way.
status: Each row: live = read successfully within 48 hours of data_updated_at; unconfirmed = last read 48 hours to 7 days before it; stopped = older; thin_market = the newest read withheld a marketplace floor because the offers were too few for one (withheld_at, withheld_reason), and the row keeps the last published floor. The site computes its figures (index, medians, cheapest, spread) from live rows only and marks the others beside the price.
slices: Per GPU: /gpu/{gpu_id}/prices.json. Per provider: /providers/{provider_id}/prices.json. Same fields, fewer rows.
